title: Prepositions of movement & time
grammarNote:
В этом уроке — два важных типа предлогов: ДВИЖЕНИЯ (как и куда мы идём) и ВРЕМЕНИ (когда это происходит).

🚶 ПРЕДЛОГИ ДВИЖЕНИЯ — они описывают, как перемещается человек:

TO — направление к цели (куда идём):
"We walked TO the park." · "She flew TO Almaty." · "Go TO the station."

INTO — вход внутрь чего-то (движение ВНУТРЬ):
"She walked INTO the café." · "Damir went INTO the mausoleum."
Сравни: "She is IN the café" (уже внутри) vs "She walked INTO the café" (вошла)

OUT OF — выход из чего-то (движение НАРУЖУ):
"He came OUT OF the building." · "Take your passport OUT OF your bag."

THROUGH — движение сквозь, через что-то (внутри пространства):
"Walk THROUGH the park — the path goes from one side to the other."
"We drove THROUGH the tunnel." · "She ran THROUGH the rain."

ACROSS — движение через (от одной стороны к другой, по поверхности):
"Cross ACROSS the bridge." · "She swam ACROSS the river."
"We drove ACROSS the whole city — from east to west."

ALONG — движение вдоль (следуя линии, маршруту):
"Walk ALONG the river path." · "Drive ALONG this road for three minutes."
"She walked ALONG Zhibek Zholy Street to the bazaar."

PAST — движение мимо (проходишь, но не заходишь):
"Walk PAST the post office — don't turn there."
"I drive PAST the library every morning."

OVER — движение над или через (мост, препятствие):
"Cross OVER the bridge — the mausoleum is in front of you."
"The plane flew OVER the mountains."

TOWARDS — движение В НАПРАВЛЕНИИ (не обязательно доходишь):
"She walked TOWARDS the station." (шла в сторону, но, может, не дошла)
"He moved TOWARDS the window."

⏰ ПРЕДЛОГИ ВРЕМЕНИ — AT, ON, IN, FOR:

AT + точное время:
"The flight is AT 8 o'clock." · "The bus leaves AT midnight." · "Dinner is AT 7 pm."

ON + день недели / дата:
"We have a lecture ON Monday." · "I arrived ON the 15th of March." · "ON Friday evening we went to the park."

IN + месяц / год / сезон / длинный период:
"She was born IN 2006." · "The trip was IN October." · "We arrived IN the morning." · "IN summer the city is full of tourists."

FOR + продолжительность (как долго длится):
"I waited FOR two hours." · "She studied FOR six hours on Sunday." · "We stayed FOR three days."

grammarExtra.title: ① TO, INTO, OUT OF — направление и вход/выход

rows.example: "Walk TO the crossroads." · "She flew TO Almaty." · "I take the bus TO the university every day."
"She walked INTO the café." · "Damir stepped INTO the mausoleum." · "Put your passport INTO your bag."
"He came OUT OF the building." · "Take your phone OUT OF your pocket." · "The plane flew out of the clouds."
"She is IN the café." (уже там) vs "She walked INTO the café." (только что вошла) — разница важна!
❌ "She went to inside." → ✅ "She went INTO the shop." · ❌ "Go to home." → ✅ "Go HOME." (home без предлога!)
"The bus goes TO the city centre." · "This road leads TO the station." · "The cable car goes TO the top."

grammarExtra.title: ② THROUGH, ACROSS, ALONG — движение в пространстве

rows.example: "Walk THROUGH the park — the path cuts from one side to the other." · "Drive THROUGH the tunnel." · "Run through the rain."

rows.form: ACROSS = через (от одного края к другому):
rows.example: "Cross ACROSS the bridge." · "She swam ACROSS the river." · "We drove ACROSS the whole city from east to west."
"Walk ALONG this road for three minutes." · "She strolled ALONG the river bank." · "Drive ALONG Zhibek Zholy Street."
THROUGH = ты внутри пространства ("through the park"). ACROSS = ты на поверхности и пересекаешь ("across the bridge/river").
ALONG = параллельно чему-то ("along the road"). ACROSS = перпендикулярно/перекрёстно ("across the road/bridge").
"Walk ALONG this road, then CROSS the bridge ACROSS the river, then go THROUGH the park to the mausoleum."

grammarExtra.title: ③ PAST, OVER, TOWARDS — движение мимо, над, к

rows.example: "Walk PAST the post office — do not turn there." · "I drive PAST the library every morning on my way to WKU."
"Cross OVER the bridge." · "The plane flew OVER the mountains." · "Jump over the fence."
"She walked TOWARDS the station." · "He moved TOWARDS the window." · "Drive towards the mountains."
PAST = снаружи, мимо ("walk past the library" — не заходишь). THROUGH = внутри ("walk through the library" — проходишь насквозь).
Оба правильны! "Walk across the bridge" (акцент на расстоянии) = "Walk over the bridge" (акцент на подъёме). Часто взаимозаменяемы.
Marat: "Walk ALONG the road → turn left → walk PAST the library → cross OVER the bridge → the post office is in front of you!"

grammarExtra.title: ④ AT / ON / IN / FOR — предлоги времени

rows.example: "The flight is AT 8 o'clock." · "The bus leaves AT 7:30." · "We met AT midnight." · "The lecture starts AT 9 am."
"We have English ON Monday." · "She arrived ON the 15th of March." · "ON Saturday we went to the park." · "ON New Year's Day."

rows.form: IN + месяц / год / сезон / часть дня:
rows.example: "The trip was IN October." · "She was born IN 2006." · "IN summer the city is busy." · "IN the morning / afternoon / evening."
"I waited FOR two hours." · "She studied FOR six hours." · "We stayed IN Almaty FOR three days." · "He lived there FOR a year."

rows.form: AT vs ON vs IN — общее правило:
rows.example: AT = маленький / точный момент (часы, полночь) · ON = средний (день, дата) · IN = большой (месяц, год, сезон)
❌ "on 8 o'clock" → ✅ "AT 8 o'clock" · ❌ "in Monday" → ✅ "ON Monday" · ❌ "at October" → ✅ "IN October"

grammarTip:
Три правила — и предлоги движения и времени всегда верные:

① Предлоги движения — задай вопрос "КАК я двигаюсь?":
   Вхожу внутрь → INTO ("walked into the café")
   Выхожу наружу → OUT OF ("came out of the building")
   Иду сквозь пространство → THROUGH ("through the park")
   Пересекаю от края до края → ACROSS ("across the bridge")
   Иду вдоль линии → ALONG ("along the road")
   Прохожу мимо → PAST ("past the library")

② Предлоги времени — запомни через размер:
   МАЛЕНЬКИЙ момент (секунда/минута) → AT ("at 8 o'clock")
   СРЕДНИЙ период (день) → ON ("on Monday")
   БОЛЬШОЙ период (месяц/год) → IN ("in October", "in 2024")
   ДЛИТЕЛЬНОСТЬ → FOR ("for two hours")

③ Запомни маршрут Зары как образец:
   Walk ALONG the road (вдоль)
   → PAST the post office (мимо)
   → ACROSS / OVER the bridge (через мост)
   → The post office is OPPOSITE the park (напротив)
   Прибыла AT 10 o'clock, ON Tuesday, IN March!

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct preposition of movement.
exercises.text: Walk ___ the park — there is a path that crosses from one side to the other.
exercises.hint: THROUGH = движение сквозь пространство (внутри). "Walk THROUGH the park" = войти с одной стороны и выйти с другой. ALONG = вдоль (не пересекая).

exercises.instruction: Fill in the correct preposition of movement.
exercises.text: She walked ___ the café and ordered a cup of tea — she had never been there before.
exercises.hint: INTO = движение ВНУТРЬ закрытого пространства. "She walked INTO the café" (вошла внутрь). Сравни: "She is IN the café" (уже там, без движения).

exercises.text: Walk ___ the post office — do not turn there — and continue straight on to the park.
exercises.hint: PAST = идти мимо, не заходя внутрь. "Walk PAST the post office" = пройти мимо него, продолжая путь. ✅ Marat's directions to Zara!

exercises.text: "Walk along the river" means walk into the water and cross to the other side.
exercises.hint: ALONG = вдоль (следуя маршруту, параллельно). "Walk ALONG the river" = идти вдоль берега реки, а не входить в воду! Войти в воду и переплыть = ACROSS the river.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the correct time preposition.
exercises.text: The flight to Karagandy departs ___ 14:30 — do not be late!
exercises.hint: AT + точное время (часы, минуты). "The flight is AT 14:30." · "The bus leaves AT 8 o'clock." Точное время → всегда AT! ✅

exercises.text: Madina visited Almaty ___ October — the weather was perfect that time of year.
exercises.hint: IN + месяц (October, March, July...). "The trip was IN October." · "She was born IN 2006." Большой период → IN ✅

exercises.text: Damir studied ___ the bus station for twenty minutes, looking at the map.
exercises.hint: AT + конкретное место (вокзал, аэропорт, остановка). "He waited AT the bus station." · "She was AT the airport." Конкретная точка → AT ✅

exercises.text: "She studied for three hours" and "She studied in three hours" mean the same thing.
exercises.hint: FOR = длительность ("she studied FOR three hours" = три часа подряд). IN = через/за время ("she will finish IN three hours" = через три часа). Совершенно разный смысл!
